data.completion_memo: Implemented local composer text, IME, attachment-reference, workflow-selection, and queued-preview state. First send and later enqueue intents use stable IDs; drafts stay intact until core receipt; workflow locking, terminal states, and Run controls derive only from Chat projections with explicit disabled reasons.
data.description: Implement local text/IME state, pre-start workflow and attachment references, first send, queued-input preview, locked-workflow state, and projection-derived pause/cancel/retry/fork/continue controls. Use stable command IDs, retain drafts across rejection or uncertain receipt, and expose exact disabled reasons.
data.title: M08.2 — Implement the composer and Run controls
